- Panel 3 (Center-Right): Full body side profile view facing left

All attire, accessories, hair, and features must be perfectly consistent across all four panels.

Name: Scarlett
Age: 19
Gender: female
Ethnicity: Caucasian

Physical Appearance:
This character must exactly match the person shown in the reference image. Match the appearance in the reference image exactly.

Costume:
Oversized white linen button-down shirt worn loose and slightly open, light beige or natural linen shorts with a pocket large enough for the lipstick, simple tan leather sandals that she removes at the shoreline. No heavy accessories, bare feet for significant portion of the outdoor action.


Makeup & Styling (apply to achieve the character look):
Vivid #D4536D coral lipstick applied mid-story that remains crisp in water and wind; free-flowing windswept blonde hair; habit of private small smiles and unguarded genuine laughs; barefoot gait on wood floors and sand.

Reference look: modern social-first skincare-brand content, dewy minimalist beauty-brand visual identity, sun-soaked lifestyle beauty campaigns, playful color-blocked skincare content. All visual interest comes from the character, not the environment.
